correctness.rationale: Over algebraically closed characteristic 3, the smooth marked family has parameters c!=0, c!=b² and (c-1)²+b²!=0. The first two quartics are separable and have disjoint geometric branch loci exactly on U; the independent (Z/2)^2 covers have eight branch points and genus 5 by Riemann–Hurwitz. The three quotient Jacobians are E_0 supersingular, E_(b,c) ordinary iff b!=0, and genus-3 G with Hasse matrix [[b,0,c],[0,c+1,0],[1,0,b]]. Its 2x2 block determinant b²-c is nonzero on U and its middle block vanishes iff c=-1. Thus stable 3-ranks and a-numbers of G are 3,0 or 2,1, respectively. The degree-power-of-two isogeny identifies 3-divisible groups, so H has 3-ranks 4,3,2, a-numbers 1,2,3 and the claimed supersingular/ordinary slope multiplicities. Inclusion–exclusion on c=0,c=b²,(c-1)²+b²=0 over F_{3^m} yields total q²-2q odd m or q²-4q+6 even m; the intersection of rank-drop lines (b=0,c=-1) is exactly one smooth parameter, yielding ranks count (1,2q-epsilon-4,(q-1)(q-3) odd or q²-6q+11 even), epsilon=0 or2. Inspected exact GF(3^m) checker construction for m=1..4 and independently confirmed characteristic-three quartic/Hasse special cases; finite tests not proof for all m.
